narrative.overview:
minportfölj.se feels like a precision instrument someone built for themselves — dark, fast, zero decorative noise. Every surface is purposefully dim so the data can speak at full volume. The interface doesn't try to impress; it tries to answer. When a user opens the tool, the question is already posed. The design's job is to get out of the way and let the numbers close it.

The palette is almost exclusively dark navy with restrained semi-transparent layering. Two accent colors — Electric Cobalt for Portfolio A, Arctic Sky for Portfolio B — do the only chromatic work. They appear on interactive elements, chart lines, and accent glows. Nothing else competes. Positive returns are Mint, negative are Coral — semantic, not decorative.

Typography pairs Syne (sharp, confident, slightly angular) for all UI chrome, labels, and headings with DM Sans (warm, readable, humanist) for body copy.
keyCharacteristics: Dark by mission: dim surfaces reduce cognitive load so numerical differences read clearly
Two-voice typography: Syne for chrome, DM Sans for content — never reversed
Accent restraint: Electric Cobalt and Arctic Sky appear on ≤20% of any surface
Functional elevation: depth via tonal layering and selective accent glow, not shadow stacking
Uppercase labels with wide tracking (0.05–0.06em) anchor every data section

rules.name: The Two-Accent Rule
rules.body: Electric Cobalt and Arctic Sky are the only saturated colors in the system. Every other chromatic touch is semantic, not decorative. Adding a third decorative accent is forbidden.

rules.name: The Opacity Stack Rule
rules.body: Component backgrounds are never solid colors — they are semi-transparent white layers on the dark field (rgba(255,255,255,0.02–0.10)). This ensures surfaces remain coherent at any depth.

rules.name: The Chrome/Content Split Rule
rules.body: Syne carries all interface chrome. DM Sans carries all explanatory prose. Swapping this breaks the system's voice.

rules.name: The Label Contract
rules.body: Every data field is preceded by an uppercase Syne label at 9px with letter-spacing 0.05em and color Steel Slate. Unlabelled data fields are prohibited.

rules.name: The Glow-Is-Semantic Rule
rules.body: The only colored shadow is the Electric Cobalt glow on Portfolio A panels. It marks which portfolio the user is interacting with. Colored glows on other elements are forbidden.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Elements are flat at rest unless elevation is necessary for layering context. Shadows and glows respond to state or depth — they are not default styling.

rules.name: The Ghost-Over-Filled Rule
rules.body: Fully filled buttons (solid Electric Cobalt background) do not exist. Buttons are always tinted ghosts. The accent is strong enough at partial opacity.

dos: Do use uppercase Syne labels (9px, 0.05em tracking, Steel Slate) above every data field
Do use rgba(255,255,255,N) for all surface backgrounds — components layer above #090d1a
Do color positive return values #6ee7b7 and negative #f87171 — everywhere, consistently
Do use slideInLeft 0.22s ease for list items that mount dynamically
Do keep Syne on all UI chrome and DM Sans only in explanatory prose
Do limit saturated color to Electric Cobalt and Arctic Sky
donts: Don't use storbankernas tunga byråkratidesign: compliance banners, legal-text overflow, multiple competing CTAs
Don't use generiska SaaS-dashboards: blå gradienter, hero-metrics, identical card grids
Don't use gamifierade fintech patterns: confetti, progress streaks, push-moment celebrations
Don't use reklamtunga jämförelsesajter patterns: sponsored slots, badge proliferation
Don't use border-left greater than 1px as a colored stripe accent on any card or row
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text) — use solid Mint or Coral for emphasis
Don't add a third decorative accent color
Don't fill a button with solid Electric Cobalt — buttons are always tinted ghosts
Don't put DM Sans on a tab, badge, label, or button — only Syne
Don't show a number without an uppercase label naming the unit
